ModMetaData.name: Project Mamono Slime Faction
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds wild slimes to RimWorld 1.6, for Project Mamono.
Seven slime species live in the wilds: the common blue slime, the fiercer red slime, the psycasting dark slime, the toxin-eating bubble slime, the brilliant taisui, the coastal sea slime, and the devoted nureonago. Four of them arrive through their own event, on land that suits them. The nureonago walks in disguised as an ordinary woman on a rainy day, and a travelling woman may be carrying a parasite slime that turns her from the inside.
A slime body is gelatinous. Her hair always matches her skin, tattoos never take, she leaves slime filth wherever she walks, and with no bones and no skin every wound she takes is a bruise. Butchering one gives slime jelly rather than skin or meat, and a living slime sheds jelly as the days pass. Each of the eight jellies keeps forever and carries its own boon - and a woman who eats enough of one melts into that slime.
Slimes are as soft as a human to the weather: any temperature that would kill a naked human kills a slime. They only enter the map through their own events, and they are tamed or captured and convinced to join like wild men.
Requires Harmony, Biotech, Odyssey, Project Mamono, and Big and Small - Framework.
